Company Description Resurface Group is a distinctive home-based program located in the Austin, Texas Metropolitan Area. Our program is tailored to the unique needs of each individual client. Unlike traditional facilities and programs, we believe that no one client is the same, so no one program can fit all clients. We work closely with our clients to develop personalized goals and a plan of action to support their recovery journey. Our client-driven environment focuses on continual progress and navigating through internal and external blocking points.
 Role Description This is a full-time on-site role as a Therapist at Resurface Group. As a Therapist, you will be responsible for conducting in-depth, comprehensive assessments of clients to define their goals and develop individualized treatment plans. You will provide therapy sessions and support clients in navigating through each stage of change. Additionally, you will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to ensure the most effective care for our clients.
 Qualifications Experience in providing individual therapy and counselingKnowledge and understanding of different therapeutic approaches and interventionsAbility to conduct comprehensive assessments and develop treatment plansStrong communication and interpersonal skillsAbility to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary teamEmpathy and sensitivity towards clients' needs and circumstancesExcellent problem-solving and decision-making abilitiesMaster's degree in Counseling, Psychology, Social Work, or related fieldLicensed or certified as a professional therapist (or eligible for licensure/certification)Experience working with individuals with substance abuse or mental health disorders is a plus
